## Announcements {.leap-section-heading}

::: {#events}
:::

```{=html}
<!-- Full-width subscribe section; submission handled by leapSubscribe()
     from partials/subscribe-widget.html (loaded site-wide). -->
<div class="leap-subscribe-band">
  <div class="leap-subscribe-band-text">
    <h2>Get new articles by owl&hellip; or email</h2>
    <p>Every article, straight to your inbox the morning it publishes. No spam, no forwarding to Mordor, unsubscribe whenever you like.</p>
  </div>
  <form class="leap-subscribe-band-form" onsubmit="return leapSubscribe(this);">
    <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="you@bagend.me" required aria-label="Email address">
    <button type="submit">Subscribe</button>
  </form>
</div>
```
